claims.proof: No slow 2B wrap before the next R exit; full target fold gives two image signs and two arrival orientations.

claims.proof: The two strict-alignment arguments differ by v/c in(0,1), so cannot both be integral. All earlier slow phases stay before x=l.

remaining_global_implication: Actual source at SAME epsilon must attain one of those exact position-and-negative-velocity entry states. Target-side nonemptiness alone does not imply source intersection.
